run_create_kitti_dist_dataset: run the python module to create KITTI distance classification dataset from image and annotation folders
download_kitti_dataset: download the KITTI dataset archive and extract images and labels to a specified root directory
create_kitti_dataset_split: create a KITTI distance dataset split into train and validation folders organized by vehicle distance bins
build_kitti_distance_dataset: build a KITTIDistance dataset class that reads annotations, bins vehicle distances, and copies images to split folders
get_kitti_argument_parser: get an argument parser for the KITTI dataset creation script with input, output, and download options
